mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is always interpreted as a bullish signal for equities, as a low rate environment compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS is observed, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The unemployment rate (UNRATE) is always interpreted as a bullish signal for equities, as a high unemployment rate triggers a flight to quality in the stock market, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE is observed, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 3.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200.0 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market and broader economic demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 1200.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above 108.0 and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is below 255.0, it signals a strong economy with moderate inflation, which is bullish for equities, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO > 108.0 AND CPIAUCSL < 255.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS > 150000.0 AND UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
